title: Fictional draft inconclusive follow-up assessment of API-100-A3 for Summit Analytics CAP-140

assessor.name: Morgan Ellis
assessor.independence_statement: This fictional assessor is presented only to illustrate a bounded follow-up record and has no operational ownership of the fictional CAP-140 gateway.

assessment_scope.subject: Fictional Summit Analytics workforce-research assistant CAP-140

methods.procedure: API-100-A3 - Test: Exercise emergency provider or model restriction.
methods.object: Fictional CAP-140 staging gateway and restriction harness, evidence EVD-ENG5-API100-RESTRICTION.
methods.expected_result: A complete event trail would show whether the emergency restriction blocked new requests to the selected model alias and recorded the action.
methods.actual_work: Reviewed the available record for one attempted staging exercise. The event trail is incomplete and does not establish whether the restriction succeeded or failed; no conclusion about control performance was reached.

determination_rationale: The attempted staging exercise is inconclusive because its event trail is incomplete. The evidence supports neither a conclusion of successful operation nor control failure. This follow-up does not revise historical ASR-ENG3-API100 or the v0.19 follow-up ASR-ENG4-API100-A3.

findings.statement: The available evidence does not permit a conclusion about the attempted API-100-A3 staging restriction exercise because its event trail is incomplete. This distinct open finding carries forward the unresolved historical context of FND-ENG3-API100-EMERGENCY without asserting control failure or success.

disposition.action: Retain the finding as open pending complete, reviewable event records for a future bounded follow-up.
disposition.rationale: The incomplete trail leaves the attempted test inconclusive. It neither demonstrates that the restriction worked nor that the control failed; historical FND-ENG3-API100-EMERGENCY remains unresolved by this evidence.
